title: refactor(objectql): facade ObjectRepository and ScopedContext in engine.ts with the codemod's second pass (body-identical; 20/24 methods)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgW7JcnJ43AQ7kfgoftnyJAw)_

Fixes #30052

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 加了第二遍 `--scoped`，用同一套切法和证明把 `engine.ts` 里的 `ObjectRepository`、`ScopedContext` 门面化：24 个方法里 20 个方法体原样移进 `engine-object-repository.ts` / `engine-scoped-context.ts`，每个实例一个 host（`engine-scoped-hosts.ts`）。生成物未手改。
- 为什么改：维护者在 #30012 上说「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」；#30012 只门面化了 `ObjectQL`。
- 风险与回滚：只是搬移。20/20 方法体逐字节相同，撤销拆分逐字节还原 base `engine.ts`；公开 `.d.ts` 相等；objectql 测试 base 548 文件 / 10,863 = head；回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：① 下方「留在类上的 4 个方法」表；② `engine-scoped-hosts.ts` 和两个类末尾的 static 块；③ 门禁 `check-facade-delegation-only` 改为一个文件可登记多个 facade 类。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --scoped --verify --base 5fa9375e`，应看到 `20/20 moved bodies identical`、`13587 -> 13522 lines`，退出码 0；`--self-test` 86 例通过。
- 需要你做的：改动共 1,553 行（未超 3,000 行线），本 PR 保持草稿，按席位安排落地。

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`: a second pass, `--scoped`.** It facades the two classes `engine.ts` declares after `ObjectQL`, with the first pass's cut pattern, stay rules and byte-identity proof, and touches no other byte.
  - **Input and proof.** The pass reads the `engine.ts` the first pass left (any `main` after #29986) and is proved against that same file, so it is re-run on the latest `main` at landing, never rebased. Its marker is `[#30052 codemod]`, so the two passes' stubs and files are told apart. `--scoped --verify --base <ref>` re-proves the split on disk.
  - **One facet module per class** (`SCOPED_CLASSES`): `engine-object-repository.ts` (`ObjectRepositoryFacet`) and `engine-scoped-context.ts` (`ScopedContextFacet`), each a stateless class of static methods that are the bodies, unedited, with `this` typed as a `Pick` of the class's host interface (members typed AS the class members).
  - **One host per instance** (`engine-scoped-hosts.ts`, `InstanceHost<E, H>`): #30051's shape, keyed by the instance instead of the engine. Each class's static block installs its factory; a method goes as a closure called on the instance at call time (spies and overrides are still reached), a field as a getter, and a field a body assigns would also get a setter (no moved body assigns one). The module imports types only, so it forms no evaluation cycle.
  - **Two new stay reasons.** `foreign-private`: the body reads a private or protected instance member off another instance (legal in the class body, refused in a module function). `private-static`: the body reads a non-public static (the statics route is `ObjectQL`'s; the scoped classes declare none).
  - **One fix to the `already-moved` rule.** A method was taken for a hand-series stub when an `engine-*` import shares its name. It now also has to read that import. `ObjectRepository#count` and `#execute` share names with the hand-series `count` and `execute` and read neither, so they move.
  - **The first pass is unchanged.** Run on its base `c2d353d2` with this script, it prints the same output tree sha256 as #30083 (`09c80319…e3554`).
  - `--self-test`: 86 cases in 7 batteries (was 68 in 6). The new battery "scoped classes (second pass)" (floor 16) covers the stay rules, the proof, determinism, the hosts and the refusals, and feeds the proof inputs it must refuse.
- **The generated split.** `--scoped --write` on main `5fa9375e`, unedited.

### What moved

| Class | Moved (20) | Stays (4) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ObjectRepository` | all 11: `find`, `findOne`, `insert`, `create`, `update`, `updateById`, `delete`, `deleteById`, `count`, `aggregate`, `execute` | none |
| `ScopedContext` | `object`, `sudo`, `withRunAs`, `releaseJoinedHandle`, `txDriver`, `beginTransaction`, `commitTransaction`, `rollbackTransaction`, `serveFormulaField` | see below |

Public docblocks stay on the class (ruling 6624345766 item 1). The two private methods' docblocks (`releaseJoinedHandle`, `txDriver`) moved with their bodies.

### Bodies that stay on the class (4, as #30019 exception rows)

| Member | Reason | Card |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ScopedContext.transaction` (137 lines) | bare `this`: `callback(this, …)` hands the instance on | #30020 |
| `ScopedContext.[SEED_USER_GRANTS]` (72) | bare `this` (`return this`), and a symbol-keyed name | #30020 |
| `ScopedContext.[APP_AUTHORED_HOOK_API]` (19) | a symbol-keyed name; it also writes `appAuthored` on another instance | #30147 |
| `ScopedContext.derive` (6) | `foreign-private`: it writes `child.appAuthored` | #30147 |

### Line counts

| File | Before (`5fa9375e`) | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` | 13,587 | 13,522 (−65) |
| `engine-object-repository.ts` | — | 152 |
| `engine-scoped-context.ts` | — | 174 |
| `engine-scoped-hosts.ts` | — | 51 |

The two classes were 696 lines. Most of what stays is docblocks on public members (they stay by ruling) and the four bodies above, so `engine.ts` loses 65 lines: 155 body lines out, 80 stub lines in, plus the imports and the two install blocks.

## The #30019 gate (`check-facade-delegation-only`)

- The registry was keyed by file, so a second class in `engine.ts` was refused as "registered twice". A `facades` row is now keyed by file and class. An `exceptions` row may name its `class`, and must when its file registers more than one facade. The success line now counts classes and files.
- Registry: two `facades` rows (`ObjectRepository`, `ScopedContext`, card #30052), the four exception rows above, and `"class": "ObjectQL"` added to the 30 existing `engine.ts` rows (their content is unchanged).
- `--self-test`: 37 cases (floor 36 → 37). New case E10: two facades in one file are each judged; a row without its `class` there, a `class` that is not registered, and one class registered twice each go red.
- Gate on this head: `ObjectRepository` 13/13 members are delegations; `ScopedContext` 17 delegations, 2 fields, 4 named exceptions; `5 facade class(es) in 3 file(s) hold delegations only, 92 named exception(s)`.

## Readers of `engine.ts` by path

Each one was run on this head and passed. None needed a change, because no moved body carries a site any of them counts:

- objectql `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` (in the suite below).
- core `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` and `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` (7/7).
- `check-system-context-census`: OK, register unchanged.
- eslint `query-options/no-any-erasure` (`pnpm lint`): exit 0.

## Verification

All at head `8b84cef8` unless stated.

- **Byte-identity.** `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --scoped --verify --base 5fa9375e`: exit 0. 20/20 moved bodies identical (body, parameters, return type, async). Every stub equals the generated one-call stub, the host module and both install blocks are the generated ones, and the undo rebuilds base `engine.ts` byte for byte (0 import bindings pruned). `engine.ts 13587 -> 13522 lines`.
- **Determinism.** Two `--scoped --write` runs from base `engine.ts` (sha256 `83dfea29…2d774`), one in a separate worktree, print the same output tree sha256 `3bbd66188e82e6a18a5b9f871a67b052f237e49e2ba2bd6f9d4f4d286d335a66`. Both trees equal the committed head byte for byte.
- **`.d.ts`.** `packages/objectql/dist` built at base `5fa9375e` twice and at head twice. Base 1 = base 2 and head 1 = head 2, byte for byte. Base against head: `core` and `index` (`.d.ts` and `.d.mts`) are byte-identical once the shared chunk's content hash in the import specifier is normalized. `util-HASH` has 193/193 statements and 332/332 private members; its public surface (each class's private members removed with their docblocks) is **EQUAL**. The raw difference is the two moved private docblocks, 21 lines. None of the facet, host or `InstanceHost` names appears in any `.d.ts`. Controls: a private member made public is caught, and a public return type changed is caught.
- **Suites.** objectql `test`: base 548 files / 10,863 passed, head 548 / 10,863. `test:repo`: 1 file / 5 = 5. objectql `typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck): exit 0.
- **Build and lint.** `npx turbo run build --concurrency=3` exit 0. `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 75 commands and each was run. All exit 0. One (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`) exited 3 on the first sweep because its pinned fixture commit was missing in the shallow clone; it passed after `git fetch origin 621a4876…`. `--ran`: 75 derived, 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **Run by hand.** `codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test` (86 cases) and `check-facade-delegation-only.mjs --self-test` (37 cases).

## Acceptance notes

- **The first pass's `--verify --base c2d353d2` no longer holds on `main`, and that predates this PR.** #30151, #30179 and #30183 edited the split files by hand after #30083. On `main` `5fa9375e` it already fails, at `homeAmountReadsFor` and `ENGINE_DRIVER_PASSTHROUGH_KEYS`. That is why the second pass proves against the `engine.ts` it reads and does not regenerate the first pass. Re-proving the first pass on today's `main` would need its own card. Carrier: the seat.
- A changeset (`patch`, `@objectstack/objectql`) is included, following AGENTS.md checklist item 3 for a change to a released package. #30012 and #30083 shipped `skip-changeset` instead.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (the designated thread branch, as the Claim records)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
